posts.title: Rendering Maps in Terminals
posts.description: I’ve been working for years with geospatial data, the ecosystem is vibrant (thanks to DuckDB), but I’ve always missed some tools in the terminal to visually look at geometries in context. I’ve started to work on a pure Go renderer, in 2025, and after 3 different iterations I finally have an API I’m happy with. posts.title: Building Cross-Language Apps: Direct QML to gRPC Without C++
posts.description: TLDR: A recent Qt update let you do gRPC calls directly from QML, allowing to interact with gRPC from the UI without requiring C++. Qt is a rich ecosystem for UI development, but its roots are in C++. QML is a declarative language specialized in designing user interface applications on top of Qt.
